crossRefs.note: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan…
You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and…
be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire…
You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods…
“ ‘ “That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families…
“Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth…
There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of…

translations.web: Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens, though the nations themselves are terrified by them.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
translations.asv: thus saith Jehovah, Learn not the way of the nations, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the nations are dismayed at them.
